title: TargetEnvelope
description: Body-tagged target envelope mirroring Analog.Semantics.TargetEnvelope + Envelope (S5: same schema for Moon and Mars), plus the declared weight family screening is certified over (S2-atlas). lo <= hi per dimension (Envelope.valid) is checked by validators, not expressible in JSON Schema.

targetName.description: e.g. Artemis south-polar candidate region name, or Mars reference landing zone

sourceDataset.description: Registry datasetId this bound was derived from

weightFamily.description: Declared family only; screening certificates are valid exactly over this family (Analog.Screening instantiations).
